# Black Sea

> Black Sea builds, repairs, staffs and tests the AML/CFT and sanctions programmes of regulated firms worldwide, deepest in frontier markets and the Gulf.

- [Home](https://blackseaops.com/): Black Sea builds, repairs, staffs and tests the AML/CFT and sanctions programmes of regulated firms worldwide, deepest in frontier markets and the Gulf.
- [What we do](https://blackseaops.com/what-we-do.html): Seven services for regulated firms: licensing build, remediation, MLRO cover, AML audit, sanctions DD, bank onboarding and perimeter review.
- [Coverage](https://blackseaops.com/coverage.html): AML/CFT and sanctions advisory worldwide. For twenty-seven markets: who supervises which licence, where reports go and who may hold the MLRO seat.
- [Firm](https://blackseaops.com/firm.html): Black Sea is an independent AML/CFT and sanctions advisory firm. What we do, for whom, how fees are set, and how we work with law firms.
- [Contact](https://blackseaops.com/contact.html): Tell us the market, the licence and what has happened. A senior practitioner replies with a costed plan: the stages, the weeks and a fixed fee for each.
- [Partners](https://blackseaops.com/partners.html): Your firm keeps the application and the legal advice. Black Sea builds the AML/CFT and sanctions programme behind it, under NDA.
- [Legal](https://blackseaops.com/legal.html): Terms of use and privacy notice for blackseaops.com: what the site collects, why, how long it is kept, and how to ask for deletion.
